tests: M-X1a R20 R5 R2 through events' real owner: a member holding 4,000 votes in the window is walked whole within the time budget, not a hub, no fan-out cut for votes; the 5,000-node bound, if met, answered as nodes, never time
M-X1a R20 R5 through events' real owner: at 4,001 votes the member is named a hub for votes alone with bound 4,000 and set size 4,001, and its other kinds are still walked

R10 presets() answers each preset by name with its kind set as registered; a kind registered later joins with no change here
R10 R15 each preset is the one walk over its set: chain, flowsFrom (payer to payee), relationsOf and pathBetween answer what explore answers over the same kinds

R11 overlaps: each record both reach in one step of the same kind whose validities meet at the date or in the period, three-valued, with both steps, the shared span and the size of the shared set; never stated as acquaintance
R11 R5 an overlap at a hub names the hub as too common to walk, with its set size
R11 R7 an overlap through a step the viewer may not see is not answered or counted
R1 refusals in order: no node, bad node, no date, bad date, unknown kind, depth over max, unknown quantity; a missing viewer fails closed first
R2 breadth-first over every owner of the asked kinds, one node per owner call, viewer, scope and host passed unchanged; with `to`, only paths ending there

R3 each path's hops as their owners answered them, its grade the weakest hop's on each axis, ordered by hop count then validity then ids; sortBy orders by a stated quantity named in the answer; no score
R4 only hops valid at the date are walked; an undetermined hop is walked, marked, and its path is undetermined, never shown as holding

R5 bounds: an owner's answer is read page by page to its end within each kind's own bound; items beyond a kind's bound are not walked and the node and kind are named; a hub is named with its kind, bound, set size and why and not expanded for that kind; the node bound and the time budget stop the walk as exhausted; every answer states visited, depth, budget and elapsed

R20 R11 the presets' period walks judge a hub per kind: an overlap of one kind is found beside the same person's hub of another
R6 a declared hop is marked declared at the lowest grade; a hunch is walked only within its inquiry and has no grade; such paths are leads with the sentence; a derived hop carries its derivation
R7 a hop the owner withholds from the viewer is not walked, and nothing in the answer counts or reveals it, visited included
R8 an answer with no path states its level in observation-log's vocabulary, how far it searched, and what owners hold as tables not read
R9 an exploration writes nothing: every table's rows are the same before and after, the registry is unchanged, nothing records who explored
R16 no answer states two nodes connected beyond the cited hops, and no outward text says knows, network, conflict, suspicious or most connected
R17 a constitutive relation is walked only as a declared hop: it never resolves a reference or carries a grade of its own
R18 no place is named in the module's outward text

R3 each path's hops as their owners answered them, its grade the weakest hop's on each axis, ordered by hop count then validity then ids; sortBy orders by a stated quantity named in the answer; no score
R4 only hops valid at the date are walked; an undetermined hop is walked, marked, and its path is undetermined, never shown as holding

R5 bounds: an owner's answer is read page by page to its end within each kind's own bound; items beyond a kind's bound are not walked and the node and kind are named; a hub is named with its kind, bound, set size and why and not expanded for that kind; the node bound and the time budget stop the walk as exhausted; every answer states visited, depth, budget and elapsed

R20 a hub is judged per kind: a hub answer to a call naming several kinds is asked again for each kind alone, a kind answered in items is walked, only a kind that is a hub alone is named; the calls count toward the budget and reveal nothing hidden
R20 R11 the presets' period walks judge a hub per kind: an overlap of one kind is found beside the same person's hub of another
R6 a declared hop is marked declared at the lowest grade; a hunch is walked only within its inquiry and has no grade; such paths are leads with the sentence; a derived hop carries its derivation
R7 a hop the owner withholds from the viewer is not walked, and nothing in the answer counts or reveals it, visited included
R8 an answer with no path states its level in observation-log's vocabulary, how far it searched, and what owners hold as tables not read
R9 an exploration writes nothing: every table's rows are the same before and after, the registry is unchanged, nothing records who explored
R16 no answer states two nodes connected beyond the cited hops, and no outward text says knows, network, conflict, suspicious or most connected
R17 a constitutive relation is walked only as a declared hop: it never resolves a reference or carries a grade of its own
R18 no place is named in the module's outward text
R27 explore declares explore: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R27 explore declares explorepreset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R28 explore declares exploreverify: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R21 the connection graph: a centre with a person one ring out and an organisation two rings out answers three nodes, two steps with their words, grades and citations, and the organisation stopped at the ring

R21 R2 R3 it is the one walk to depth `rings`: each step once even when reached from both ends, nodes and steps in the order of the paths that reach them, never ranked or scored

R3 each path's hops as their owners answered them, its grade the weakest hop's on each axis, ordered by hop count then validity then ids; sortBy orders by a stated quantity named in the answer; no score
R4 only hops valid at the date are walked; an undetermined hop is walked, marked, and its path is undetermined, never shown as holding

R5 bounds: an owner's answer is read page by page to its end within each kind's own bound; items beyond a kind's bound are not walked and the node and kind are named; a hub is named with its kind, bound, set size and why and not expanded for that kind; the node bound and the time budget stop the walk as exhausted; every answer states visited, depth, budget and elapsed

R20 a hub is judged per kind: a hub answer to a call naming several kinds is asked again for each kind alone, a kind answered in items is walked, only a kind that is a hub alone is named; the calls count toward the budget and reveal nothing hidden
R20 R11 the presets' period walks judge a hub per kind: an overlap of one kind is found beside the same person's hub of another
R6 a declared hop is marked declared at the lowest grade; a hunch is walked only within its inquiry and has no grade; such paths are leads with the sentence; a derived hop carries its derivation
R7 a hop the owner withholds from the viewer is not walked, and nothing in the answer counts or reveals it, visited included
R8 an answer with no path states its level in observation-log's vocabulary, how far it searched, and what owners hold as tables not read
R9 an exploration writes nothing: every table's rows are the same before and after, the registry is unchanged, nothing records who explored
R16 no answer states two nodes connected beyond the cited hops, and no outward text says knows, network, conflict, suspicious or most connected
R17 a constitutive relation is walked only as a declared hop: it never resolves a reference or carries a grade of its own
R18 no place is named in the module's outward text

R1 refusals in order: no node, bad node, no date, bad date, unknown kind, depth over max, unknown quantity; a missing viewer fails closed first
R2 breadth-first over every owner of the asked kinds, one node per owner call, viewer, scope and host passed unchanged; with `to`, only paths ending there

R3 each path's hops as their owners answered them, its grade the weakest hop's on each axis, ordered by hop count then validity then ids; sortBy orders by a stated quantity named in the answer; no score
R4 only hops valid at the date are walked; an undetermined hop is walked, marked, and its path is undetermined, never shown as holding

R5 bounds: an owner's answer is read page by page to its end within each kind's own bound; items beyond a kind's bound are not walked and the node and kind are named; a hub is named with its kind, bound, set size and why and not expanded for that kind; the node bound and the time budget stop the walk as exhausted; every answer states visited, depth, budget and elapsed

R20 a hub is judged per kind: a hub answer to a call naming several kinds is asked again for each kind alone, a kind answered in items is walked, only a kind that is a hub alone is named; the calls count toward the budget and reveal nothing hidden
R20 R11 the presets' period walks judge a hub per kind: an overlap of one kind is found beside the same person's hub of another
R6 a declared hop is marked declared at the lowest grade; a hunch is walked only within its inquiry and has no grade; such paths are leads with the sentence; a derived hop carries its derivation
R7 a hop the owner withholds from the viewer is not walked, and nothing in the answer counts or reveals it, visited included
R8 an answer with no path states its level in observation-log's vocabulary, how far it searched, and what owners hold as tables not read
R9 an exploration writes nothing: every table's rows are the same before and after, the registry is unchanged, nothing records who explored
R16 no answer states two nodes connected beyond the cited hops, and no outward text says knows, network, conflict, suspicious or most connected
R17 a constitutive relation is walked only as a declared hop: it never resolves a reference or carries a grade of its own
R18 no place is named in the module's outward text

R3 each path's hops as their owners answered them, its grade the weakest hop's on each axis, ordered by hop count then validity then ids; sortBy orders by a stated quantity named in the answer; no score
R4 only hops valid at the date are walked; an undetermined hop is walked, marked, and its path is undetermined, never shown as holding

R5 bounds: an owner's answer is read page by page to its end within each kind's own bound; items beyond a kind's bound are not walked and the node and kind are named; a hub is named with its kind, bound, set size and why and not expanded for that kind; the node bound and the time budget stop the walk as exhausted; every answer states visited, depth, budget and elapsed

R20 a hub is judged per kind: a hub answer to a call naming several kinds is asked again for each kind alone, a kind answered in items is walked, only a kind that is a hub alone is named; the calls count toward the budget and reveal nothing hidden

R6 a declared hop is marked declared at the lowest grade; a hunch is walked only within its inquiry and has no grade; such paths are leads with the sentence; a derived hop carries its derivation
R7 a hop the owner withholds from the viewer is not walked, and nothing in the answer counts or reveals it, visited included
R8 an answer with no path states its level in observation-log's vocabulary, how far it searched, and what owners hold as tables not read
R9 an exploration writes nothing: every table's rows are the same before and after, the registry is unchanged, nothing records who explored
R16 no answer states two nodes connected beyond the cited hops, and no outward text says knows, network, conflict, suspicious or most connected
R17 a constitutive relation is walked only as a declared hop: it never resolves a reference or carries a grade of its own
R18 no place is named in the module's outward text
